KubeJS
======

 

What does this mod do?
----------------------

This mod lets you create scripts in JavaScript language to manage your server, add new blocks and items, change recipes and tags, add custom handlers for quest mods, change worldgen and more!

How to use it?
--------------

Run the game with mod installed once. It should generate kubejs folder in your minecraft directory with example scripts. startup scripts only get run once when the game loads. Those are for registering items, setting up configs etc. Server/data scripts are loaded when you join a world, those are better for things like clearlag, displaying custom login messages and world/player related things in general.

 Video tutorial for 1.19.2

 

Can I reload scripts?
---------------------

Yes, use /reload . Note: Not everything is reloadable. Some things require you to restart game, some only world, some work on f

soundsbegone:
Sounds Be Gone! 
 

Inspired by my own misophonia, Sounds Be Gone keeps Minecraft playable when specific noises are overwhelming. The mod passively records every sound you have heard in the past minute and lets you mute any of them permanently with a couple of clicks. Everything is client-side, so your preferences affect only your game.

 Fabric is supported on releases below 1.20. NeoForge builds are available for Minecraft 1.20.4 and newer. 

 Why players use Sounds Be Gone

- Instantly silence any sound event (vanilla or modded) without memorizing filenames.
- The "recently played" list removes guesswork—scroll, select, and mute.
- Keeps an audit trail so you can easily unmute later when you change your mind.
- Built for sensory accessibility: predictable UI, reversible actions, and zero server requirements.

 Infrequent Sounds (since version 1.5)!

Some sounds are useful in small dos

couplings:
Coupled usage of doors, fence gates, and trapdoors

- Double doors (with opposing hinges) will open together when used
- Vertically stacked fence gates will open together when used
- All trapdoors (and opposing counterparts) along their side axes will open together when used
- Any redstone signal above 7 (50%) will power all coupled blocks, whereas anything less will only power the immediate block 
- Each coupled block can be individually toggled in the configuration file (./config/couplings.toml)

 This mod is recommended on both the client and server for more responsive block updates

tt20:
TT20
TT20 helps reduce lag by optimizing how ticks work when the server's TPS is low.

 

 Regarding singleplayer
Singleplayer should work fine! You can use the mod on the client without problems.

 🤔 What does TT20 stand for?
TT20 is an abbreviation of the ticks tps/20 formula. It's used to calculate the amount of ticks something takes, while taking the TPS into account.

 ⚠️ Caveats
TT20 only fixes the symptoms of TPS lag, not the actual lag. It re-calculates the amount of ticks things take. For example, when you're breaking a block it takes the original break time, multiplies it by ticks and divides it by 20 (the maximum TPS). This ensures that the end user feels almost no lag, even if the TPS is very low.

 ⚙️ Roadmap
 Finished
- Block break delay
- Eating delay
- Item pickup delay
- Block entity tick acceleration (experimental, off by default)
- Portal delay
- Sleeping delay
- Poti

TT 20型 TT 20可在服务器的TPS较低时，通过优化分笔成交点的工作方式来帮助减少延迟。 单人游戏应该工作得很好！你可以在客户端上使用模组而没有问题。 TT 20代表什么？ 🤔 TT 20是tps/20分笔成交点公式的缩写，用于计算某个项目所需的分笔成交点数量，同时考虑TPS。 注意事项 TT 20只修复TPS滞后的症状，而不是实际的滞后。它重新计算所需的分笔成交点数量。例如，当你中断一个区方块时，它会将原来的中断时间乘以分笔成交点，再除以20（最大TPS）。这可以确保最终用户几乎不会感觉到滞后，即使TPS非常低️。 路线图 完成️ 方块中断延迟 - 饮食延迟 - 项目取货延迟 - 图方块像素记号加速（实验性，依预设关闭） - 入口延迟 - 睡眠延迟 - Poti - Poti

compact-chat:
Compact Chat is a Minecraft mod that removes duplicate messages from your chat with many options for customization.

 
 
 
 

 

 Compatibility with other mods

Compact Chat aims to be compatible with other mods, especially those which add timestamps to the start of messages.

By default, Compact Chat will not compact messages which start with a timestamp, but that behavior can be configured
by adjusting the "Ignore first characters count" setting within the configuration screen (requires
ModMenu to open!).

 

If this value is set, Compact Chat will ignore the first characters in the message up until the specified length.

For example, with the setting set to 10 and a message like so:

 
[20:19:00] hello!
 

Compact Chat will see it as:

 
 hello!
 

 License

 What this mod does
- This mod is registering an empty argument, making it required on clients if your server has it installed. Players who try to remove it from their modpack can't join your server.

- Automatically ban people based on Xray texturepacks
- Provide an easy way to find xraying users in-game

Abstract

Thank you for choosing our Mod Whitelist mod to protect your server from client hacking mods. Let me introduce how it works and what you can do.

This mod works on client and server separately:

- On the client side, it gathers all identifier of mods ("mod id"s), encrypted them and send to the server.
- On the server side, it checks players who try to connect the server if they install hacking mods, or if they do not install any necessary mods to avoid problems.

But both sides are required. If not:

- Installed on the client side but not installed on the server side. The client player can still enter the server and play, but this mod can not protect your server from hacking.
- Installed on the server side but not installed on the client side. The client player is not allowed to enter the server and sent message "multiplayer.disconnect.mod whitelist.packet corruption".

infiniverse:
Infiniverse is an API that allows other mods to add and remove dimensions during server runtime. It provides no features or content on its own.

Infiniverse is primarily a server mod and not required on clients (it is also compatible with vanilla clients). However, if the Infiniverse mod is present on your client, any new/removed dimensions will be immediately available in command suggestions for commands that take dimensions as arguments (such as /execute in ). If Infiniverse is not present on your client, you will need to log out of the server and log in for these changes to be visible in command suggestions.

Documentation for developers can be found in the project readme on github via the "sources" link above.

AudioShutdown
If you often have Minecraft running in the background, you might have noticed that your pc cant go to sleep. That's because the audio engine requests your pc to stay awake. With this mod, the engine gets shutdown while you are not in a world and there is no audio playing!

This mod probably isn't for you if you just play minecraft casually. But for server owners, modders etc. keeping Minecraft open 24/7 isn't often that unusual. Minecraft's Audio Engine says to Windows that it should never put your pc to sleep because it's streaming audio even while you don't even hear ANYTHING.

A simple server-side mod that allows you to pick up villagers.

 Planned Features
- Add a config option to change which entities can be picked up

Ecstatic 

 

Ecstatic is an LOD mod designed to be as efficient and as close to vanilla performance as possible, while allowing you to hit render distances of over 256 chunks

 

CC BY NC SA 4.0 Liscence, source at https://github.com/Wizardtastic/Ecstatic

To get the best possible experience, I would highly suggest turning your vanilla render distance up to 24 from the default 12, LODs really don't look that great up close

This technique is both lighter on the CPU and GPU for generating and rendering terrain at far distances.

A Minecraft mod that lets you place blocks on top of any block (so you could also do it with carpets via config), by lowering the entire block (model, collision, etc.). Read more to find out about the Offset Tool!

 This mod doesn't modify anything permanently, therefore you can remove it or add it back at anytime! 

 

There is an Offset Tool (found in the Tools & Utilities tab) which toggles lowering per-block. Offsets are off by default except for blocks sitting directly on a dirt path or bottom slab, and you can turn them on or off by right-clicking with the Offset Tool.  How it works

 Routes over real terrain, not straight-line distance.

 Blocks used for bridging are budgeted against what you actually carry. 
 A route that needs more blocks than you have is only offered when there is no other way through, and the HUD tells you how many are missing. A route that would burn through most of your stack loses to a slightly longer one that places fewer blocks. Turn on strictLimits if you would rather get no route than one that breaks these limits.
 Minecart routes, even beyond your render distance. 
 XaeroNav remembers the rails you have s

For regular condensed milk you need:

2. Craft a tin can from 6 andesite alloys

4. You can drink

1. Prepare regular condensed milk

Cacophony is an Ambient Sounds mod for TerraFirmaCraft, that uses its unique climatic and seasonal systems to play immersive wildlife sounds.

At the time of release, there are over 100 species of bird, many of which migrate between climates, nearly 50 species of frogs, 20 varieties of cricket, and a handful of cicadas. Additionally, Cacophany includes a wind sound system that takes into account the current speed and direction of the in-game wind.

Unlike traditional ambient sound mods, Cacophony doesn't play a static looping track that only changes when you move between biomes. It plays sounds of individual animals at points all around the player, which merge together to create a unique and ever-changing cacophony.

i-see-your-chunks:
I See Your Chunks

 
 
 
 

 I See Your Chunks renders distant players standing on real terrain , far past your render distance. Instead of a player model floating in empty space at the edge of the world, the server streams the chunks that player is standing in, and your client draws them as actual geometry — with real occlusion, live block updates, and correct depth against your LOD terrain.

 ⚠️ Clients need Voxy. Voxy is what renders the streamed terrain. Without it a client still shows distant players and mobs, but floating with no ground under them. Dedicated servers do not need Voxy (it's a client-only mod). See How It Works.

forcegl:
❓ForceGL

 Force your game to use a modern OpenGL version! 

ForceGL is a lightweight Minecraft mod that overrides Minecraft's default OpenGL context version and requests OpenGL 4.6 instead of OpenGL 3.2 .

---

 🤨 What is ForceGL?

ForceGL modifies Minecraft's graphics initialization process and tells GLFW to create a newer OpenGL context when the game starts.

The goal is simple:

 Request OpenGL 4.6 on supported systems
 Allow Minecraft to run on a modern OpenGL context

---

 ⚙️ How does it work?

During startup, Minecraft requests an OpenGL 3.2 context by default.

ForceGL injects into the game's window creation process and changes the requested OpenGL version to:

 Platform Requested Version 
 --------------- ----------------- 
 Windows / Linux OpenGL 4.6 
 macOS OpenGL 4.1 probably

If your graphics driver supports the requested version, Minecraft will run using that newer OpenGL

===============

Makes anvil penalties (experience cost, anvil usage increase) of certain anvil interactions more balanced.

Balanced Anvils is fully functional as a server-side mod , but can be installed on the client and used in singleplayer too.

---

Features
--------

The experience costs added by repairing and renaming are removed. The anvil usages will not increase for renaming/repairing items.

In other words, if the result does not have different enchantments compared to the first item , the interaction will be free. Otherwise, it will cost experience and increase the anvil uses.

 

 Example Cases

 Slot 1 Slot 2 Result Is It Free?

 Netherite Sword Rename Renamed Netherite Sword Yes

Brute Force Culling Revamped is a modern multiloader port of Brute Force Rendering Culling Revived.

 What does the original mod do?

Brute Force Render Culling is a performance mod that improves how Minecraft handles rendering.

It uses advanced occlusion culling techniques to skip drawing chunks, entities, and block entities that the player
cannot see. By cutting out this hidden work, the mod reduces the strain on chunk compilation and rendering, which helps
keep frame rates steadier in heavy modpacks or areas crowded with blocks and mobs.

 The biggest gains show up in enclosed spaces or builds with lots of occlusions , while open landscapes see less
impact. Rendering tasks are canceled early at the CPU stage, saving resources before they ever reach the GPU.

betterms:
BetterMS is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that improves the player list by replacing the default ping bar indicators with the actual ping value displayed in milliseconds. Instead of guessing your connection quality from a set of bars, you get a precise numerical readout that updates in real time.

The mod color-codes each ping value based on latency thresholds, making it easy to identify connection quality at a glance. Low latency values appear in green, moderate values in yellow, and high latency values in red, following a consistent and intuitive color scale.

BetterMS is designed to be completely unobtrusive. It has no configuration screen by default on most versions, requires no setup beyond installation, and adds no overhead to your game. rifts:
Rifts introduces physical rifts in your world which teleports all entities to the linked location. The rift is made with obsidian and an end crystal, and must be linked to a lodestone through a compass.

You can have as many linked rifts as you want, and they keep on teleporting after the lodestone is removed.

Teleports all entities, including items and mobs.

No tick functions

 
 How to open a rift. 

1. Place an obsidian with a crying obsidian 3 blocks above, with a 2 block gap between.
2. Place the end crystal on the obsidian, and right click it with a lodestone compass; consuming the compass.
3. Right click the end crystal with an ender eye to create a rift; consuming the eye.

Overview
EMI GameStages Link is a Minecraft Forge mod that integrates EMI with GameStages to display lock info directly inside EMI’s item list and recipe screens.
​
If an item or recipe is stage-locked, the mod can show a lock icon overlay, a “Locked to ” label, tooltip details, and a colored highlight on locked outputs.
​

Features
- Automatic ItemStages integration (detects locked items with no config).
- Automatic RecipeStages integration (detects locked recipes with no config).
- Lock icon overlay on locked items/outputs.​
- “Locked to ” label above locked recipes.
- Tooltip info showing the required stage on hover.​
- Highlight locked output slots (configurable color).
- EMI item list integration (lock icons in EMI search/item list panels).

How to Use the Mod

This mod lets you control exactly where your character is looking by typing a simple command.

To change your view, type:

/orientation (yaw) (pitch)

Yaw changes the direction you are facing left or right.
It controls horizontal movement, like turning on a compass.
Positive and negative numbers turn you in opposite directions.
You can use whole numbers or decimals for more precise angles.

Pitch changes whether you are looking up or down.
Higher values usually make you look downward.
Lower or negative values make you look upward.
This is helpful when you need accurate camera angles for building, testing, or showing something clearly.

Example Commands

/orientation 90 0
/orientation 180 -30

As soon as you enter the command, your view changes instantly.

The mod also includes this command:

/orientation lock

When you use it, your current yaw and pitch are locked. Mo

TPS Overlay shows server and client performance on screen without opening the F3 debug overlay. You get TPS, MSPT, ping, and FPS in a small HUD that you can move around and tune to your liking.

The text line uses a custom format with placeholders - show only what you care about. There's also an optional graph that scrolls over time; turn individual metrics on or off if the panel feels crowded.

On servers with the mod installed, TPS and MSPT are measured properly and sent to clients. On a vanilla server you'll still see ping and FPS; server metrics simply won't appear. Use /tpso help for client commands and /tpsc when you want numbers in chat.

Config is in YACL (Mod Menu button if you have it). Position both widgets with /tpso edit .

Selective Grindstone is a minecraft mod to allow using an enchanted book to select which enchantments should be removed from an item placed in a grindstone. If you input, for example, a diamond sword with Sharpness V, Unbreaking III, and Looting II and a sharpness book (of any level), only the sharpness enchantment will be removed. Nvidium swaps Embeddium/Sodium’s renderer for an NVIDIA‑only one that pushes more terrain rendering/culling to the GPU for a big FPS boost (especially at high render distances). 

Nvidium is normally a Fabric mod, but this pack makes it work on Forge using Sinytra Connector and Forgified Fabric API (plus Embeddium and a few tweaks).

What this modpack aims to improve:
- Tick stability
- FPS
- Faster chunk loading

Note: 
- Nvidium on Forge is still experimental.
- The modpack doesn’t change vanilla gameplay.
- Nvidium only works on supported NVIDIA GPUs.
- If your GPU isn’t supported, Nvidium won’t run (it can disable itself), but removing/disabling it is still recommended for stability.
- Nvidium disables itself when shaders are active.

Issues can be posted in the comments for now. (will make a discord server later)

- Powered by Fabric

- Owners of weak PCs who get tired of lags in modpacks. 
- Players on Linux , where Vulkan runs more stable than OpenGL.

💎 Amethyst Reforge

 Upgrade at the smithing table. Recycle at the blast furnace. 

A fully vanilla data pack that turns equipment progression into a two-way street: reforge your gear up or down the material tiers, and reclaim resources from anything you no longer need — no waste, no dead-end items.

 ✨ Features

 🔨 Smithing Table Upgrades & Downgrades

Using amethyst shards as the upgrade template, freely move tools, armor and horse armor up or down the material chain — go from wood to netherite, or scrap netherite back down to iron if you need to.

 Tools (pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel, hoe, spear):
- Wooden ↔ Stone ↔ Copper ↔ Iron ↔ Golden ↔ Diamond ↔ Netherite

 Armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots):
- Leather ↔ Chainmail ↔ Iron ↔ Golden ↔ Diamond ↔ Netherite
- Copper armor integrates into the same chain alongside iron and gold

 Horse Armor: 
- Leather ↔ Iron ↔ Copper ↔ Golden

This resourcepack reimagines Minecraft's Graphical User Interface with a warm, cozy and dark style, taking vanilla's more simple design and transforming it into something fancier and more visually appealing, perfect for those late night sessions.

It features a soothing coffee color for all inventories, recolored text to better fit the color scheme (works better on newer versions), a brand new hotbar with remade icons for hearts, armor and food, as well as special skull shaped hearts for the hardcore players.

 

 Compatibility

Made for most versions of Minecraft. Support will mainly come for the latest versions of Minecraft, I'm the only one maintaining this pack and I don't have that much time.

Latest versions from 1.21.2 have more features thanks to Mojang's changes on how resourcepacks work, a custom highlight texture, custom bundle inventory, custom scrollbars

In Minecraft, there is a bug where if you get an enchantment with level higher than 10, it will show the level as enchantment.level. ; For example, If I get an axe with efficiency 15 , smite 25 , and unbreaking 10 , it will show as efficiency enchantment.level.15 , smite enchantment.level.25 and unbreaking X .

This texture pack fixes that. WIth this texture pack, level displays (both for potion effects and enchantments) will now cap out at level 255 instead of level 10 (level 6 for potion effects). 

It also has support for roman numerals (numbers like V, X, IX, III), but only until level 15. after level 15, to avoid confusion, it will switch to regular numbers (numbers like 15, 29, 69, 50). It still caps out after level 255 though.

🪐 Orbit-Shader
A deferred rendering shaderpack for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21+, built for the Iris and Sodium ecosystem on Fabric.
Orbit-Shader provides a cinematic visual experience through a modern deferred pipeline, with granular in-game settings to scale performance from integrated graphics to high-end GPUs.

✨ Features
Physically Based Rendering (PBR)
Supports standard PBR resource packs using a GGX BRDF lighting model. Metallic blocks reflect light sharply; rough surfaces scatter it naturally. Requires a PBR-compatible resource pack to take effect.
Screen Space Reflections (SSR)
Water and rain puddles dynamically reflect surrounding geometry and the sky.
Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO)
Adds soft contact shadows in corners, crevices, and dense foliage for a grounded sense of depth.
Filtered Shadow Mapping
PCF (Percentage-Closer Filtering) with shadow map distortion produces

4. Set the token and chatId options in the config.yml file to the values obtained in step 3.
5. Set the prefix option to a string that will be used as a prefix in the messages sent to the Telegram chat (optional).

 Usage
